description: Department of Labour - Notify the Wages Board for the Retail and Wholesale Trade (Objection will be received until 02.07.2018
reasoning: This gazette notification pertains to proposed variations to wage decisions under the Wages Boards Ordinance (Chapter 136) for the Retail and Wholesale Trade sector. It involves regulatory changes to minimum wage rates, which falls under legal/regulatory matters concerning labor regulations and statutory instruments. The content does not involve government structure/personnel changes or fit any other specialized categories besides legal/regulatory matters.
